claim: Simon Green: OU connection first, then the official citation, which stays as written.

suggestion.to: A main-belt asteroid named after space scientist John Zarnecki, formerly of the Open University. Its official naming citation reads: “John C. Zarnecki (b. 1949), of the Open University, Milton Keynes, has developed spacecraft instrumentation to study the surfaces and atmospheres of planets, satellites and small bodies. He is a PI for the Huygens probe/lander on the Cassini mission to Saturn and Saturn VI (Titan).” The shape model of this object is awaiting further study - and it may or may not be accurately represented in this visualisation.
